text:
Switchgear | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the testing procedures P1, 
which must be performed every two years as indicated by Y2 in the title block.
The first draft initiated 
by eng. Hanan Elbadrawy, revised by eng Ayman Ayyad, tested by eng Fahmy 
Abd El Khalek, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Adel Abd EL-Qader El Nagar, 
accepted by general director eng Fawzy Elzemety, and approved by eng. Awad Fathy 
Head Sector of Talkha PS.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC MPIS coordinator & inspection and 
 quality control general director, and certified by accountant Mahmoud 
 Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, quality control general 
 director and supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff 
 should carry the suitable safety category.
Maintenance staff should be well trained, qualified or 
 directly supervised by some one who is.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear the personal protective equipment must used as 
 safety shoes, safety helmet ...etc
CT must be out of service and isolated from the network
Tools and Equipment
Cable set 15m (49 ft)
2*15m (49 ft) 95mm (current cables )
2*15m (49 ft) 2.5mm (sensing cables)
The tester MOM 690
Power 
 supply
Work to be Carried Out
IMPORTANT :
 the sensing cables must be 
 connected inside the current cables.otherwise the test data will be 
 incorrect. See fig.
Measuring the 
 resistance of a breaker
Make certain the line is de-energized on both side of the 
 breaker .ground the breaker on one side and make certain it is closed
Ground the microhmmeter.
Make certain the microhmmeters 
 ON/ OFF while making connections.
IMPORTANT :
 the sensing cables must be 
 connected inside the current cables.otherwise the test data will be 
 incorrect. See fig.
Switch on theMOM690 .
Select AUTOor MAN with the <func> button.
Set output current to zero to start the 
 measurement. cables must be connected inside the current cables.
Increase the current to the desired value (600A 
 for example ).
Read the resistance value.
Measuring 
Resistance at Busbar Joints
Ensure the line is de-energized and the test 
 object is grounded.
Ground the microhmmeter.
Make certain microhmmeters ON/OFF switch is OFF 
 while making connections
Connect the microhmmeters current cables to the 
 test object . do not connect the sensing cables . measurement will be done 
 manually using an external portable voltmeter
Switch on the MOM690
Select MAN with the < FUNC > button.
Set output current to zero to start the 
 measurement
Increase the current to the desired value (100A 
 for example ).
Using an external voltmeter , measure the voltage 
 drop across each contact element within section of the busbar being tested . 
 the voltmeter must be set to DC .
Calculate the actual resistance.
Example 
:
If the voltage drop is 0.0067V at a current of 100A 
the resistance will be 0.0067/100 Ώ i.e67 μΩ
